title: Diane Powell's medical licence revoked
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Diane Powell's medical licence revoked, about unspecified at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Her medical license got revoked for studying these telepathic children.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a doctor named Diane Powell had her medical licence taken away because she studied children said to be telepathic, meaning able to read minds. He connects her to The Telepathy Tapes, a project about these children. If that is what happened, it would mean a doctor lost her right to practise for looking into this subject.
